description: Registers a seller (provider) under the test key via POST /providers/register and returns providerLinkCode (needed to create goals) and webhookSecret (to verify webhooks). Idempotent on externalCreatorId. webhookUrl must be a public https URL that reaches the user's receiver, e.g. an ngrok or cloudflared tunnel to localhost. Sandbox webhooks are real signed HTTP requests.

email.description: Must not belong to an existing Trickl provider. Default: a per-seller @example.com address

externalCreatorId.description: The seller's id in the user's app. Default: sandbox-seller-1

stripeConnectAccountId.description: Leave empty in sandbox: a placeholder is used, since sandbox goals never reach Stripe

webhookUrl.description: https URL of the user's webhook receiver

websiteUrl.description: Seller site; its host is allowed for redirects and embedded checkout

name: register_test_provider
title: Register a sandbox seller
